MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Steppenwolf, Tom Petty, and Born in the U.S.A. fit the familiar classic rock mood reflected in my Cars album and classic rock compilations.",
    "Off The Wall connects with my pop interests reflected in Born This Way, although I would choose the rock albums this time."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Elvis: Ultimate Gospel does not match my current rock and pop mood; enjoying older music does not mean I am looking for gospel.",
    "Own The Night feels outside my current interests because contemporary country is less appealing to me right now than the classic rock choices.",
    "Greatest Hits, Ultimate Collection, and 16 Most Requested Songs leave me unsure whose music I would get, so I cannot confidently connect them to my tastes."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hits collections seems to have been taken as interest in almost any collection, when the artist and musical style are what make me choose one.",
    "My varied listening seems to have been interpreted too broadly; liking some pop and older recordings does not make every style equally appealing right now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated classic rock and familiar-song choices in my history matter more to my current decision than simply whether an album is a compilation.",
    "My Christmas album choice was tied to a particular listening occasion and does not by itself indicate that I want a gospel collection."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in familiar hits, but sometimes miss the artist, style, and listening mood that make those hits appealing to me."
}
